creature_families: Serpulo ground mech, 5 tiers: dagger, mace, fortress, scepter, reign (UnitTypes.java l.100-291)
Serpulo boost-mech, 5 tiers: nova, pulsar, quasar, vela, corvus (l.357-585)
Serpulo legged crawler, 5 tiers: crawler, atrax, spiroct, arkyid, toxopid; leg count rises (l.661-914)
Serpulo air, 5 tiers: flare, horizon, zenith, antumbra, eclipse (l.1047-1263)
Serpulo support and builder, 5 tiers: mono, poly, mega, quad, oct (l.1345-1547)
Serpulo naval gunship, 5 tiers: risso, minke, bryde, sei, omura (l.1577-1892)
Serpulo naval support, 5 tiers: retusa, oxynoe, cyerce, aegires, navanax (l.1943-2325)
Erekir tank, 5 tiers: stell, locus, precept, vanquish, conquer (l.2654-2969)
Erekir legged and hover, 5 tiers: merui, cleroi, anthicus, tecta, collaris (l.3153-3615)
Erekir fast flyer, 5 tiers: elude, avert, obviate, quell, disrupt (l.3789-4149)

top_creatures.label: Hex-leg burrower (own label)
top_creatures.why: Leg count is the escalation signal, so the silhouette grows tier by tier.
top_creatures.keep: Legged gait that rises by leg count; ground-only walking
top_creatures.change: Leg rig, body shape, sound; drop the acid and creep identity
top_creatures.ref: core/src/mindustry/content/UnitTypes.java l.701-926 (atrax l.701, legCount l.714, l.750, l.819, l.926)

top_creatures.label: Crush-tread bulwark (own label)
top_creatures.why: Tank tier whose signature is damage on contact with what it runs over.
top_creatures.change: Tread design and a bulwark role instead of a rolling wall

top_creatures.label: Bubble carrier (own label)
top_creatures.why: Slow hovering support; the shield bubble makes others hide behind it.
top_creatures.change: Dome shape and the bubble shader (not the hex field)
top_creatures.ref: core/src/mindustry/content/UnitTypes.java l.1547-1571 (force field l.1569, repair l.1571)

top_creatures.label: Suppression leviathan (own label)
top_creatures.why: Naval capital whose field suppresses nearby enemies; very readable from far away.

top_creatures.label: Heavy titan mech (own label)
top_creatures.why: Largest Serpulo ground mech; reads at a distance.
top_creatures.keep: Large walking mech as the top tier
top_creatures.change: Give it our own signature ability; none is declared on this unit

top_creatures.label: Boost-hop mech line (own label)
top_creatures.why: Walker that hops over obstacles and gains a force field as it grows.
top_creatures.change: Hop trigger and a different field
top_creatures.ref: core/src/mindustry/content/UnitTypes.java l.357-585 (canBoost l.358, l.398, l.457, l.518; force field l.473)

top_creatures.label: Death-brood husk (own label)
top_creatures.why: The dying unit releases a small brood, so death is a second event.

top_creatures.label: Rebuilder drone (own label)
top_creatures.why: Small support that repairs nearby allies and structures.
top_creatures.change: Our own visual and repair rule

classes: No player classes in this donor.

Unit roles (by movement and purpose): ground mech, boost mech, legged walker, air, support and builder, naval gunship, naval support, core unit, Erekir tank, Erekir legged and hover, Erekir fast flyer, neoplasm spawner.
Factions (core/src/mindustry/game/Team.java l.33-41): derelict, sharded, crux, malis, green, blue, neoplastic. Only crux is traced to an effect (boss status tint).
Progression shape: each line steps up one tier at a time, five tiers deep; the newest tier adds one ability or a larger body.
weapon_families: Families by bullet class in ammo wiring (Blocks.java): basic, artillery, flak, shrapnel, missile, rail, plain bullet; 20 ammo blocks
Serpulo turrets, 18: duo, scatter, scorch, hail, wave, lancer, arc, parallax, swarmer, salvo, segment, tsunami, fuse, ripple, cyclone, foreshadow, spectre, meltdown (Blocks.java l.3276-4341)
Erekir turrets, 10: breach, diffuse, sublimate, titan, disperse, afflict, lustre, scathe, smite, malign (Blocks.java l.4378-5959); reinforced drawer setup

Ammo items as the tier signal in the wiring: copper, lead, scrap, graphite, silicon at the bottom; thorium, pyratite, blast compound, surge alloy higher; plastanium, phase fabric, oxide, carbide, tungsten, beryllium further out
Status on hit (status = StatusEffects.X in Blocks.java, UnitTypes.java, Bullets.java): burning, wet, blasted, shocked, melting, tarred, slow, muddy, freezing, corroded
Turret tier visual distinctness: not read
gear_tiers: No gear sets and no armour items. Unit armour exists only as a shader (core/assets/shaders/unitarmor.frag).
Core tiers, 6: core-shard, core-foundation, core-nucleus, core-bastion, core-citadel, core-acropolis (Blocks.java l.3145-3225; names bundle.properties l.1942, l.2283).

Materials, 22 items (core/src/mindustry/content/Items.java): copper, lead, metaglass, graphite, sand, coal, titanium, thorium, scrap, silicon, plastanium, phase-fabric, surge-alloy, spore-pod, blast-compound, pyratite, beryllium, tungsten, oxide, carbide, fissile-matter, dormant-cyst. Top tier reads as surge-alloy, phase-fabric, plastanium, fissile-matter, dormant-cyst.
Material look: not read (sprites not opened).
zones: Planets (core/src/mindustry/content/Planets.java): serpulo l.123, erekir l.46, sun l.29, tantros l.107 (sun and tantros not read further)

Serpulo presets, 29 (SectorPresets.java l.22-156), e.g. frozenForest, taintedWoods, ruinousShores, windsweptIslands, tarFields l.132, navalFortress l.99, coastline l.89, desolateRift l.142, nuclearComplex, impact0078
Erekir presets, 17 (SectorPresets.java l.166-236): onset, aegis, lake, intersect, atlas, split, basin, marsh, peaks, ravine, caldera, stronghold, crevice, siege, crossroads, karst, origin
Weather types (core/src/mindustry/content/Weathers.java): snow, rain, sandstorm, sporestorm, fog, suspended particles
Hazard surfaces (names only, not opened): core/assets/shaders tar.frag, mud.frag, slag.frag, cryofluid.frag, caustics.frag
Dungeon archetypes: capture-by-waves (captureWave, SectorPresets.java l.25) and waves-then-attack (attackAfterWaves, l.182)

looks.label: Banded build-in reveal
looks.technique: Alpha times a progress value, times a sine band mask on sprite height

looks.label: Forcefield with wobble and edge glow
looks.technique: Sine texture wobble; edge glow from max of four neighbour samples; diagonal sparkle from modulo on screen coordinates

looks.label: Permanent team-tinted boss status
looks.technique: Status effect with team colour tint and health and damage multipliers

looks.label: Planet with atmosphere shell
looks.technique: Planet and atmosphere vertex and fragment pair (names only, not opened)
